content: If you want one year of prosperity, plant seeds. If ten years, plant trees. If a hundred years, cultivate people.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Guanzi (Classical Statecraft Treatise of Guan Zhong)
explanation: Short-sighted leaders obsess over quarterly balances and annual harvest yields. But the only investment that defies historical ruin is the moral, intellectual, and spiritual cultivation of the next generation. True greatness leaves behind not monuments, but noble humans.
practicalInsight: Invest deliberate time into mentoring, encouraging, or teaching a younger colleague or child today without seeking personal credit.
reflectionPrompt: Are you spending all your energy on temporary harvests, or are you investing in the lasting legacy of human cultivation?
